cf2b1671df330a88dd4b173f2b100bb26126dfea: A resort on a human scale, Albiez-Montrond focuses on warm welcome and closeness rather than impressive figures. Its 35 km of runs are a perfect fit for a 3- to 4-day stay, especially for families or skiers who don't need to keep changing their playground. Albiez-Montrond's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Albiez-Montrond's altitude (1,500 m at the base, 2,100 m at the top) helps it keep a decent snow cover in mid-winter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it's worth checking conditions before finalising a booking. The 25€ day lift pass remains reasonable for the quality of the ski area on offer. Once you add accommodation, skiing and meals, Albiez-Montrond suits those who want a good week without the final bill making them fall off their chair. In short: Albiez-Montrond is one of those rare resorts that combines a real village, a sincerely family atmosphere and runs suited to everyone. It's hard to go wrong with a stay here.

cf586cf66c442897aa4996569a8c490da4244f7f: A resort on a human scale, La Norma focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than impressive figures. Its 65 km of runs are ideal for a 3 to 4 day stay, especially for families or skiers who do not need to constantly change their playground. La Norma's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for children's first steps on skis. With a summit at 2750 m and a village at 1350 m, snow reliability at La Norma is generally good from January to the end of March. A few exceptionally mild winters can cause shortages early in the season, but the situation recovers quickly once serious snowfalls arrive. At €44, the day lift pass places La Norma among the mid-range resorts on budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies the price for most skiers. In short: La Norma keeps its promises. A resort in the Northern Alps that will suit most profiles without disappointing.
